name: Ash Wednesday
overview: Ash Wednesday reminds believers of their humble origin and mortality, as Scripture declares that man was formed from the dust of the ground and will return to dust (Genesis 2:7; 3:19; Ecclesiastes 3:20). This solemn acknowledgment calls Christians to repentance and dependence on God's Spirit, who brings healing and liberty to the brokenhearted and captive (Isaiah 61:1). The imagery of marking the forehead in Ezekiel 9:4 highlights God's protection over those who mourn sin and seek His righteousness. Ultimately, Ash Wednesday points to the need for spiritual renewal and a clear vision of God, as Job experienced when he saw the Lord with new eyes (Job 42:5).
